description: This Java class 'ImmutableOrderInterceptor' extends 'ImmutableEntityInterceptor' to enforce immutability constraints on 'Order' objects within the OpenMRS framework, allowing only specific fields to be mutable.

classes.name: ImmutableOrderInterceptor
classes.description: A Spring component that intercepts 'Order' entities to restrict modifications to specific fields, ensuring data integrity within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getSupportedType
methods.description: Returns the class type 'Order' which this interceptor supports.

methods.name: getMutablePropertyNames
methods.description: Provides the list of property names that are permitted to be modified for 'Order' objects.

methods.name: ignoreVoidedOrRetiredObjects
methods.description: Indicates whether voided or retired objects should be ignored by this interceptor, returning true.
